title: A Bioactive Janus Barrier Membrane Rejuvenates Bone Regeneration in Aging
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Aging significantly impairs guided bone regeneration (GBR) by disrupting stem cell recruitment and exacerbating cellular senescence. To address this challenge, we engineered a quercetin and Sr-hydroxyapatite/poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (QSHP) Janus ...
